qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Customized mission-critical tank transmissions (e.g. Leopard 2, Puma) create high engineering switching costs, but bargaining power rests with prime system integrators (KNDS, Rheinmetall) and sovereign defense agencies, resulting in a 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 10.44% (sub-12% hurdle).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (3b=N, REJECT). Specialized defense transmission manufacturer fails the 12% multi-cycle GAAP ROIC hurdle (median 10.44%, 7.1-7.9% in 2022-2023) and lacks pricing power against prime contractors and defense ministries.
qualitative.evidence: 4-year median GAAP ROIC is 10.44% (2022: 7.9%, 2023: 7.1%, 2024: 13.0%, 2025: 15.2%). Triton PE carve-out left high net debt (€362M) relative to pre-2024 earnings. Pricing power is bounded by OEM primes (KNDS, Rheinmetall).
